_comment: Per-product + catalogue overrides for /range-csv-batch (The Range Mirakl). Mirrors config/tesco_overrides.json. Colour is per-brand here (The Range is multi-brand); brand itself comes from the Shopify vendor. GPSR economic-operator fields are REQUIRED for compliance but left blank until Wayne supplies the real registered details — never guess an address.

gpsr._comment: Fill from the registered GPSR responsible-person details, then these flow into every row. Manufacturer fields default per-brand below; economic operator is the GB importer/responsible person.
